metadata.description: Canonical deduplicated CX-001 through CX-031 execution order for Atlas + ChatGPT production hardening.

steps.title: Lock deployment provenance and evidence capture

instructions_json.goal: Verify the exact deployed build, production URL, and evidence recording path before new work begins.

required_live_verification: production state matches expected build
steps.rollback_note: Pause further work if deployment provenance cannot be reconciled.

steps.title: Eliminate remaining Assistants API dependencies before the 2026-08-26 deadline

instructions_json.goal: Migrate remaining runtime dependencies to Responses-first architecture.

required_live_verification: live runtime no longer depends on Assistants API
steps.rollback_note: Revert only the migration unit if live read-back fails.

steps.title: Stabilize the connector gateway contract

instructions_json.goal: Expose a trustworthy connector gateway so clients can resolve available integrations without guessing.

required_live_verification: gateway returns bounded connector metadata
steps.rollback_note: Pause if connector discovery becomes stale or misleading.

steps.title: Harden connector schema lifecycle management

instructions_json.goal: Version connector capability schemas so upgrades and drift are observable.

required_live_verification: live connector schema metadata exposes revision state
steps.rollback_note: Rollback if schema updates can silently break clients.

steps.title: Complete connector lifecycle state-machine enforcement

instructions_json.goal: Make connector setup, ready, degraded, and blocked transitions canonical and read-back safe.

required_live_verification: connector lifecycle states are canonical and explainable
steps.rollback_note: Stop if connector health transitions can no longer be trusted.

steps.title: Enforce public MCP authentication and authorization boundaries

instructions_json.goal: Require valid OAuth scopes and fail closed on unauthenticated public MCP requests.

required_live_verification: public MCP rejects missing or invalid auth
steps.rollback_note: Rollback immediately if public auth protections weaken.

steps.title: Complete idempotent mutation journal and write provenance

instructions_json.goal: Ensure canonical writes carry idempotency, correlation, and provenance metadata.

required_live_verification: mutation journal fields are visible in canonical state
steps.rollback_note: Stop if canonical writes become non-idempotent.

steps.title: Normalize change envelopes and rollback metadata

instructions_json.goal: Persist before-state, after-state, verification state, and rollback notes in a consistent canonical envelope.

required_live_verification: canonical mutations read back with verification metadata
steps.rollback_note: Pause if canonical changes can no longer be audited end to end.

steps.title: Complete canonical session bootstrap contract

instructions_json.goal: Fresh sessions must reconstruct durable project context and capability state.

required_live_verification: bootstrap surface returns authoritative context
steps.rollback_note: Rollback if fresh session context becomes incomplete or misleading.

steps.title: Deliver cross-session continuity

instructions_json.goal: Make unfinished work resumable from canonical checkpoints across interrupted sessions.

required_live_verification: new session resumes exact unfinished canonical work
steps.rollback_note: Stop if checkpoint and resume state becomes inconsistent.

steps.title: Upgrade Universal Ingestion to v2 provenance semantics

instructions_json.goal: Version source events, claims, provenance, and supersession semantics.

required_live_verification: durable memories explain origin and supersession history
steps.rollback_note: Do not advance if provenance lineage becomes ambiguous.

steps.title: Separate health, observability, and truth planes

instructions_json.goal: Expose trustworthy health and status signals that do not fabricate underlying state.

required_live_verification: health surfaces align with canonical evidence
steps.rollback_note: Rollback if health reporting can claim unsupported readiness.

steps.title: Modernize MCP protocol semantics and compatibility

instructions_json.goal: Keep protocol negotiation and capability exchange aligned with current MCP behavior.

required_live_verification: protocol read-back matches live server behavior
steps.rollback_note: Rollback if clients become incompatible with the public MCP surface.

steps.title: Harden event-driven sync and cursor durability

instructions_json.goal: Move synchronization toward durable, replay-safe event handling.

required_live_verification: sync state survives retries without duplication
steps.rollback_note: Stop if sync can silently lose or duplicate events.

steps.title: Strengthen canonical session checkpoint durability

instructions_json.goal: Persist enough checkpoint detail to recover after interruption without re-inventing progress.

required_live_verification: checkpoint state survives resume boundaries
steps.rollback_note: Pause if interrupted sessions cannot be reconstructed from canonical state.

steps.title: Complete identity discovery across connectors and projects

instructions_json.goal: Resolve the active identity and project context without client-side guesswork.

required_live_verification: clients can inspect identity context explicitly
steps.rollback_note: Stop if identity selection becomes ambiguous.

steps.title: Ship durable plan-execute-verify orchestration

instructions_json.goal: Ensure orchestration loops are resumable and protocol-aware.

required_live_verification: orchestration state reads back canonically
steps.rollback_note: Rollback if automation loops become non-durable.

steps.title: Enforce canonical project scope boundaries

instructions_json.goal: Prevent cross-project leakage in reads, writes, and projected status.

required_live_verification: server returns only scoped project state
steps.rollback_note: Rollback if project boundary protections weaken.

steps.title: Make approval requirements server-side and explicit

instructions_json.goal: Return exact approval requirements from canonical policy instead of relying on narration.

required_live_verification: server returns exact approval requirements
steps.rollback_note: Rollback if approval classification drifts from server policy.

steps.title: Add command and dashboard surfaces on top of trustworthy state

instructions_json.goal: Expose status, connector, resume, and system commands from canonical APIs.

required_live_verification: command layer reflects the same canonical data as execution APIs
steps.rollback_note: Do not ship commands that fabricate health or capability state.

steps.title: Add provider remediation and retry control loops

instructions_json.goal: Make degraded providers diagnosable and recoverable through bounded remediation flows.

required_live_verification: provider remediation paths are explicit and bounded
steps.rollback_note: Stop if remediation loops can create hidden repeated failures.

steps.title: Expand production release gates and deployment safety

instructions_json.goal: Block unsafe releases unless tests, evidence, and read-back checks pass.

required_live_verification: deployment gating blocks unsafe releases
steps.rollback_note: Rollback if critical release gates can be bypassed.

steps.title: Ship Codex execution automation and machine-readable work format

instructions_json.goal: Codify execution runs, progress accounting, and evidence rules so Codex can finish work durably.

required_live_verification: Codex can report canonical step progress and resume work
steps.rollback_note: Do not advance if progress reporting is not backed by canonical state.

steps.title: Harden privacy routing and sensitive-memory boundaries

instructions_json.goal: Keep secret and sensitive content on the correct canonical path with explicit rejection behavior.

required_live_verification: sensitive writes fail or route correctly in production
steps.rollback_note: Rollback immediately if secret handling boundaries regress.

steps.title: Extend continuity across devices and clients

instructions_json.goal: Carry resumable canonical state across device or client changes without losing context.

required_live_verification: work can resume accurately after client/device switches
steps.rollback_note: Pause if client handoffs lose authoritative state.

steps.title: Enforce completion evidence bundles and done criteria

instructions_json.goal: Require commit, test, deployment, and production evidence before work can be marked done.

required_live_verification: completion state is impossible without required evidence
steps.rollback_note: Stop if tasks can be marked complete without canonical proof.

steps.title: Harden Neon recovery and database remediation safety

instructions_json.goal: Make database recovery procedures explicit, tested, and safely reversible.

required_live_verification: recovery path is explicit and validated
steps.rollback_note: Stop if recovery assumptions remain unverified.

steps.title: Validate backup and restore integrity

instructions_json.goal: Prove backups, restores, and state rehydration are measurable and trustworthy.

required_live_verification: backup and restore evidence is available and current
steps.rollback_note: Rollback if restore integrity cannot be demonstrated.

steps.title: Apply performance improvements behind quality gates

instructions_json.goal: Ship cost or latency optimizations only when quality stays above the defined floor.

required_live_verification: optimizations do not outrun measured quality
steps.rollback_note: Disable optimizations immediately if they reduce correctness or traceability.

steps.title: Gate experimental routing behind explicit evaluation

instructions_json.goal: Keep experimental model or route changes off by default unless evaluation is current.

required_live_verification: experimental routing cannot bypass quality controls
steps.rollback_note: Disable experiments immediately if routing reduces reliability.

steps.title: Ship transcript enrichment without breaking provenance

instructions_json.goal: Enrich transcripts or conversation state only when provenance and quality remain intact.

required_live_verification: enriched transcripts still expose trustworthy provenance
steps.rollback_note: Disable transcript enrichment if it reduces correctness or traceability.
